response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT pc.college_id, COALESCE(TRIM(co.state), '') AS state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN college co ON co.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, COALESCE(TRIM(co.state), '')), t AS (SELECT state, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS ratio, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c) SELECT state, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_avg, AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_total FROM t GROUP BY state
